SELECT id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time,
unit_number, unit_name, unit_desc_cn, unit_desc_en, mdm_use_flag, unit_type, enable_flag
FROM sys_md_base_measure_unit
WHERE deleted = 0
AND unit_number LIKE CONCAT('%',#{vo.unitNumber},'%')
AND unit_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{vo.unitName},'%')
AND unit_desc_cn LIKE CONCAT('%',#{vo.unitDescCn},'%')
AND unit_desc_en LIKE CONCAT('%',#{vo.unitDescEn},'%')
AND mdm_use_flag = #{vo.mdmUseFlag}
AND unit_type LIKE CONCAT('%',#{vo.unitType},'%')
AND enable_flag = #{vo.enableFlag}
ORDER BY update_time DESC
